description: Search for files on the computer by name, type, date, or content keywords. Optionally open the found file.

query.description: What to search for (file name, extension, keyword, date hint like 'yesterday' or 'last week')

file_type.description: File extension filter e.g. 'pdf', 'docx', 'xlsx', 'py'. Leave empty for all types.

location.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to Desktop, Documents, Downloads.

open_result.description: Whether to open the found file automatically. Default: true.

example_commands: open the Excel file from yesterday
find the PDF I downloaded last week
